Title: SN->SR->LLR->TC join + orphan set
Detail: Loads the four registries, computes the orphan set (SR without LLR/TC, LLR/TC without a parent, SN without an SR), and exits 1 under --strict.

Title: Id + CSV-structure + citation integrity
Detail: Duplicate/malformed id detection per ID_PATTERNS, a per-row column-count check, and SR/LLR citation coherence (triangle_findings, Thread 50); the always-valid --strict-integrity floor.

Title: Placeholder + schema checks
Detail: -000 example-row scan and required-field + closed-vocabulary validation over the real (non-placeholder) rows.

Title: Comparative-term advisory
Detail: Flags an AcceptanceCriteria comparative term with no predicate marker in the cell; warn-only, never joins the failure set.

Title: Off-spine integrity + back-links
Detail: Integrity-checks the PB/MOD/PART/ASSET ids and resolves MOD DelegatedSRs against the SR set; -000 example rows ignored.

Title: Gate step plan + missing-tool guard
Detail: Builds the required-step plan per gate/tier and reports SKIP(missing) with a nonzero exit when a required tool is absent.

Title: Stack profile loader
Detail: Reads format/lint/test/tiers/coverage/arch-map from docs/stack.ini and resolves each step's command from that profile.

Title: Profile validation
Detail: Rejects a malformed profile, non-integer coverage threshold, or missing declared binary with a clear loud failure.

Title: Conditional profile seeding
Detail: Selects the file/skill set per stack+domain scope; omits Python-only artifacts and seeds files-mode arch-map for a non-Python stack.

Title: Scaffold writer
Detail: Writes the mapped kit files into --dest so the generated harness runs green out of the box.

Title: Idempotent write + kit-version stamp
Detail: Skips an existing file unless --force; write_kit_version stamps docs/kit-version (SHA + date, -dirty on an uncommitted kit tree) so a re-sync is diffable.

Title: Link + vision-tag checker
Detail: Resolves intra-repo links, requires a PROJECT-VISION tag, and checks generated-doc freshness under --stale.

Title: Flow-doc contract checker
Detail: Validates an authored runtime-flow doc against its structural contract; a malformed flow fails.

Title: Budget comparator
Detail: Compares measured metrics to declared budgets and fails beyond tolerance at the row's block/warn level.

Title: PB back-link resolution
Detail: Resolves each PB row's Refs to a real SR/LLR/Module id; an empty or unresolvable Refs is a finding.

Title: Stub marker detector
Detail: Walks the AST for stub bodies (pass-only/NotImplemented/ellipsis public functions) at the declared gate.

Title: Secrets pattern scan
Detail: Always-on scan of staged diff/message/outgoing range for PEM/token/key patterns, independent of the privacy toggle.

Title: Two-axis privacy gating
Detail: Adds the PII/identity classes when docs/privacy-check is on, exempting configured author identities.

Title: Pre-commit floor
Detail: Runs trace --strict-integrity and the check_privacy secrets scan on staged content and blocks a failing commit.

Title: Pre-push outgoing scan
Detail: Scans the outgoing commit range and blocks a push that would publish a secret or a private identity under privacy-check.

Title: Hook python probe
Detail: Probes candidate interpreters by running one and skip-or-reports clearly when none works or a Store-alias exits nonzero.

Title: Vendored-doc drift check
Detail: Compares a vendored doc copy against its recorded upstream source and reports drift.

Title: Arch-map splice + drift check
Detail: Regenerates the symbol map inside the BEGIN/END marker block and fails --check when the committed map has drifted.

Title: Permutation expander
Detail: Parses the Permutations grammar (range/set/bool with @full|@pairwise|@boundaries) and emits the concrete case set.

Title: Skills index generator
Detail: Reads each SKILL.md applicability frontmatter and regenerates skills/INDEX.csv.

Title: Headless resume loop
Detail: Reads the next action from docs/status.md and runs the agent CLI headless with stdin closed so no prompt wedges the loop.

Title: Preflight footing guard
Detail: Refuses a non-git dir, a missing agent CLI, or a private author under privacy-check with a typed nonzero exit rather than hanging.

Title: Typed outcome + ERROR handling
Detail: Ends each session in a typed code, guards a zero-commit HEAD, and reports an all-ERROR region as an unavailable agent, not a work stall.

Title: Kernel advisory lock
Detail: Takes an OS advisory lock the kernel releases on process death, so no stale-pid file wedges the next run.

Title: Lock mutual exclusion
Detail: Refuses a second coordinator holding the same per-worktree lock, preventing a two-writer race.

Title: Shared declared-line parse
Detail: The single first-non-comment-line reader the hooks, agent_loop.read_declared, and check_privacy all use so a declared policy value is read one way.

Title: Onboard/dev-setup templates
Detail: The onboarding and dev-setup scaffold scripts that materialize and run to a green developer setup; dev-setup also wires the pre-commit floor (core.hooksPath) from its baseline.

Title: Release checklist generator
Detail: Emits docs/release-checklist.md, including a Performance-budgets section listing each warn-tier PB (id + allocation) read from the budgets registry.

Title: WI-registry validation
Detail: Loads work-items.csv and validates it: well-formed WI ids, resolvable predecessor refs, an acyclic dependency DAG (the cycle is named on failure) and unknown-SR warnings; plus the status.md-vs-registry SSOT rules (ssot_findings): R-A Deliverable-iff-done as a hard error, R-B..R-E status coherence + SpecRef resolution as warn / --strict-error; staged_findings adds the warn-first no-validation-delta check. Vacuous on a placeholder-only or absent registry; docs/trajectory-check: off silences the gate step.

Title: Offline project-state dashboard
Detail: Renders the root PROJECT_STATE.html as one self-contained offline page: completeness tiles (spine_stats), the SN->SR->LLR->TC icicle (arch_icicle), the layered roadmap DAG (dag_svg), the module-map view parsed from architecture.md's generated block (sw_modules; omitted without a symbol inventory), the optional CMP table (cmp_rows), the OKF knowledge-concept graph read from the committed docs/okf bundle (know_graph/_okf_nodes; descriptions embedded + docs/okf link-outs; omitted without a bundle so a bundle-less repo is byte-identical), the git-derived as-of stamp (_asof - last source-touching commit, never now(); ASOF_RE excludes the line from the compare), and the responsive mobile shell; deterministic bytes; --check regenerates and byte-compares (the trajectory-map gate step).

Title: Duplicate-block detector
Detail: Tokenizes each source file (stdlib tokenize; comments/NL/indent excluded, NEWLINE kept so windows cannot stitch unrelated statements), slides a --min-tokens window (default 30), merges overlapping hits by line offset into one finding per block, POSIX-normalizes the file pair, and suppresses pairs recorded in docs/dupes-allow.

Title: Per-phase cmd map + size tripwire
Detail: cmd_map parsed by parse_model_map (same KEY=value syntax; templates may not contain , or ; — the dispatcher wrapper covers those); session_template(phase) falls back to AGENT_CMD; every map entry preflighted (parse + executable); review-policy read via read_declared and printed in the banner; status_size_warning is pure and warn-only (limit<=0 disables).

Title: Path + sym: reference checker
Detail: Scans root *.md + docs/**/*.md; a backticked token is path-shaped when it carries a separator plus a known extension or top-level prefix (URLs/globs/placeholders excluded); GENERATED marker blocks and path-ok lines are skipped; sym:<module>.<name> is resolved against the module map parsed from architecture.md (module tail -> public symbols); warn-first, --strict exits 1.

Title: OKF bundle emitter
Detail: emit() builds {relpath: content} for every real row (sorted, deterministic, no timestamps): frontmatter via JSON-quoted YAML scalars, bodies carrying the row prose plus up/down markdown links from locally built reverse maps, per-tier and root indexes, the UPSTREAM.md spec pin; on_disk() snapshots docs/okf for the byte-compare; write mode writes-if-changed and prunes; small loaders duplicated per the F5 rule (no new sibling import). Layer B2 adds a process-guides tier: _doc_title_and_summary derives each guide title+summary from the doc first heading/paragraph (inline links stripped so nothing dangles), emitted only after the vacuity gate so a fresh scaffold stays vacuous.

Title: Subagent spawn gate
Detail: Pure decide(tool_name, policy, override) -> allow|ask|deny|defer over SPAWN_TOOLS={Task,Agent}; main reads the PreToolUse JSON payload, reads docs/subagent-gate via the shared declared-line parse, applies the SUBAGENT_GATE=allow override, emits permissionDecision (deny -> exit 2), and appends each decision to docs/subagent-gate.log; any exception fails OPEN (allow) and logs, so a broken gate never wedges the agent's tools.

Title: IF-tier integrity in trace.py
Detail: Reads docs/requirements/interfaces.csv and filters real (non -000) rows; integrity_findings(IF, ...) flags a malformed/duplicate IF id (the always-on floor); interface_findings(ifs, sr_ids, module_ids) makes an empty or unresolvable SR-Refs a --strict finding (the PB back-link idiom, so every seam links the spine and stays transitively TC-covered) and a ThisProject endpoint resolving to no normalized LLR Module a warn-only advisory (the LLR Module set is a partial, differently-named inventory, so check_trajectory owns the full arch-map coverage). Absent interfaces.csv is vacuous.

Title: Architecture-connectivity views and coverage warns
Detail: check_trajectory.interface_findings emits warn-first coverage keyed on the arch-map inventory (arch_inventory parses architecture.md generated block for module names + Contracts citations): default-on connectivity-undeclared when interfaces.csv is empty or absent for a multi-module map, per-module missing-endpoint and missing-direction warns with a source/sink Notes honesty valve, Active-seam-TC and Contracts-vs-registry citation warns; docs/interfaces-check off or a <=1-module inventory is vacuous. gen_trajectory.sw_graph renders the seams as a module/file/external graph reusing the WI-DAG layouter (byte-deterministic; table fallback when no seams), and gen_arch_map merges module-to-module IF edges plus harvests Contracts docstrings. No path changes an exit code.

Title: Model routing + fixed escalation policy
Detail: load_registry parses docs/agents.csv as the pair-row model (Family/Model/Version identity + CmdTemplate/Env access, one row = one model x route pair; legacy Provider read as Family; id charset [A-Z0-9][A-Z0-9.-]*, tier vocab, dup detection; id is a join key never parsed) and load_enabled reads the ordered docs/agents-enabled pool; resolve_enabled/resolve_token map a version-less token to the newest pair in its Family-Model line (exact-id else dotted-numeric then maturity-rank then date; preview/exp skipped unless named or only; equal-key route pairs by registry order; load_tag_rank supplies the per-registry maturity vocabulary); parse_env parses the Env cell the loop merges over the launch environment; select(pool,tier) picks by enable-list preference order honoring per-pair cooldown (cool/available generalize the rate-limit backoff), the Family-keyed heterogeneity preference (prefer a different family, degrade to same-family when none - a router shares its native sibling's Family), and walks a tier UP never down; escalate(rounds) is the fixed win-stay/lose-shift decision (margin>=2 primary, swap after 2 failed gates, tier-up only after the swap fails, page on shared-failure/contradiction/tripwire) with per-repo-overridable constants; failure_action keys the page-the-human semantics to docs/gate-policy.

Title: Loop-side reviewer dispatch + managed routing
Detail: When docs/agents-enabled is present (managed mode; absent = today's behavior byte-for-byte) a committing non-review session schedules REVIEW-A (and REVIEW-B under review-policy 2) before the next build; each session's model is routed via agent_route.select at the phase tier (phase_tier / --tier-map), reviewers excluding the implementer's (and REVIEW-A's) Family, and a selected pair row's Env is merged over the session launch environment (empty Env inherits the ambient environment - today's call); the redacted reviewer_prompt (embedded default, or a --prompt-map/AGENT_PROMPT_MAP template FILE, {verdict} slotted) never carries the implementer self-assessment; verdicts are read from docs/reviews/NNN-<phase>.md, merged mechanically, scored, recorded, and fed to escalate; a page-human decision enacts failure_action (attended stops NEEDS-HUMAN); every selection/cooldown is logged before launch and preflighted up front.

Title: Substance scorer + tripwires + scoreboard
Detail: parse_verdict reads the log.md block + the VERDICT machine line; substance is the mean of the available components (anchored_precision - unresolved anchors cost precision, capped; actionability; corroboration - cross-family weighted above same-family; confirmed_rate when a follow-up diff is supplied) with length never a positive term; fired_tripwires are non-scored GATES (finding-count-mismatch/cap-pinning, near-duplicate review text, an implementer diff touching a review/policy path, mass finding-rejection); merge_verdict is the mechanical no-debate merge; record_round maintains docs/reviews/scoreboard.txt (decayed per-provider tallies + the round history escalate reads) - advisory only.

Title: Cross-agent skill fan-out drift check
Detail: gen_skills_index.check_agent_sync byte-compares each per-agent <agent>/skills/<name>/ file (.claude/.gemini/.agents) to the neutral project-trajectory/skills/<name>/ source; a copy that diverges is a --check-agents finding with a one-command fix, an orphan copy (no source) a non-failing warn, a source skill missing from a subset dir no finding. Vacuous without a source or per-agent dir; wired as the check.py skills-sync step + pre-commit floor (kit-only generator, so a scaffold no-ops). bootstrap.sync_agent_skills (--sync) force-refreshes only the <agent>/skills/<name>/ subtree from source.

Title: Run capability menu reader
Detail: load_capabilities parses the docs/stack.ini [run] section (configparser, interpolation=None, case-preserving optionxform; declaration order kept; a name.desc row attaches to its command and an orphan or empty-value command is dropped) into an ordered (name,command,desc) list; --list prints name<TAB>desc per row; direct(name) launches by exact-match name (exit 2 on an unknown name) and launch() runs the shell line via subprocess shell=True - the user's own declared command, the same trust boundary as the retired RUN_CMD - passing the child exit code straight through; interactive_menu prints the numbered menu, reads a pick from stdin, and returns EOF-safe without hanging; an absent or empty [run] prints guidance and exits 1. The run.* launchers are thin delegates forwarding their args to run_menu.py.

Title: Critique loop dispatch + lax-TC ratchet
Detail: In managed mode load_critique_srs reads the Verification=Critique SR ids (empty = vacuous); a committing build whose commit-subject WI ids (build_scope_srs, joined through work-items.csv SR-Refs) deliver a Critique SR schedules a CRITIQUE phase before the next build, independent of the review dial. The critic routes provider-heterogeneous (agent_route.select, prefer-different from the implementer, strong tier by default, tier-up-never-down) with critique_prompt = the embedded CRITIQUE_PROMPT (or a --prompt-map CRITIQUE FILE) slotting the redacted critique_brief (rubric text + SN/SR intent + the TC Parameters artifact recipe, never the implementer self-assessment) and {verdict}; the verdict lands at docs/reviews/NNN-CRITIQUE.md, parsed by score_reviews.parse_verdict. CHANGES-REQUESTED loops BUILD<->CRITIQUE preserving the per-scope round count until APPROVE or AGENT_CRITIQUE_MAX (default 3, env-overridable, min-1 fallback) trips agent_route.failure_action(gate-policy) - attended stops NEEDS-HUMAN, autonomous schedules a design-check. check_trajectory.critique_ratchet_findings adds the --staged warn when a Critique WI closes under a CHANGES-REQUESTED verdict with no TC/tests/docs-rubrics delta. Absent the enable-list or any Critique SR, byte-for-byte today's behavior.

Title: How-SW top-view containment rule + render
Detail: component_top_view is the one home for the module->CMP join (arch_inventory modules x load_cmps CMP rows x module_components LLR Component tags; _cmp_roots resolves PartOf to top-level roots, cycle-guarded); component_findings bounds the top view at TOP_VIEW_MAX=10 (top-level roots containing a module + uncontained modules), warn plain and error under --strict, opt-out via docs/components-check and vacuous for a <=10-module or arch-map-less inventory; gen_trajectory.sw_containment imports the same derivation to render the containerized <details> top view (expandable members + nested children + boundary-aggregated cross-component seams; flat fallback when no CMP contains a module), and build_html routes software CMPs to How-SW and non-software CMPs to the How-physical table.

Title: Derived-gate computation + hybrid cache
Detail: Per-artifact gate rules (sr_gate/maturity_gate/sn_gate) + min-aggregation over in-scope artifacts + the cached docs/gate (basis line + --check rot guard, legacy value-only).

Title: Process reference tab
Detail: Renders the Process tab as a fully self-contained conditional panel registered in build_html (the Knowledge-tab pattern: nav button + section id=process): (1) the artifact-lifecycle x gates panel derived from the live registries + docs/gate (current-gate highlight; per-tier counts from the spine), (2) the resume-loop panel (the managed agent_loop flow with its escalation edges), (3) the slices -> campaigns -> gates panel derived from work-items.csv campaign bins; links out to the process masters wherever a canonical home exists (bounded in-view restatement only where no single doc states the relationship); sorted inputs, no clocks; a data-less repo renders byte-identically; --check unchanged (the trajectory-map step).

Title: Tiered When/How-SW drill-down (interface-wired, descend-a-layer)
Detail: Revised for the SR-051 amendment (WI-134 [v3]-[g1], owner-sanctioned): the tiered When/How-SW views render Simulink-style - IF-### seams attach to their endpoints' block input/output ports at every visible tier and a cross-container seam aggregates to the container boundary; double-click on a container block (with a keyboard alternative - Enter/Space on a focused block) descends one layer into it and a breadcrumb path restores the parent view, superseding the shipped in-place-<details>-expand/no-zoom render (the Q3 ruling the rev supersedes). Retains the count-thresholded tiering (phase->workstream->work item when a tier's member count exceeds 3, flat at or below; the How-SW view containerizing components into modules per the WI-073 idiom, bounded above at TOP_VIEW_MAX) and the deduped parent-to-parent edge aggregation. Self-contained (no external fetches), byte-deterministic; --check unchanged. Data-side graph extensions (typed-IF contracts, cyclic render) stay WI-064. Rebuilt at the WI-141 dev slice (a shared drill renderer: block input/output ports, IF-/dependency-edge wires, double-click / Enter-Space descend-a-layer, breadcrumb) across both the When and How-SW views; re-Verified.

Title: Dashboard accessibility rendering
Detail: Renders PROJECT_STATE.html operable and readable without a pointer or full colour perception: every interactive element (tab buttons, expandable <details> blocks, SVG nodes with detail panels) is keyboard-reachable (native focusable elements or tabindex+key handler) and carries an accessible name (a <title>/aria-label or visible text); every status/phase/type encoding pairs its colour with a text or shape cue (never colour alone); text keeps a contrast ratio against its fill at or above the threshold declared in docs/rubrics/dashboard-accessibility.md (WCAG 2.1 AA). The design is adjudicated against that rubric by the SR-047 critique loop - this LLR names the code surface the critique judges (Critique is non-LLR-exempt per SR-047). Self-contained, byte-deterministic; --check unchanged.

Title: Dashboard UI-uniformity rendering
Detail: One shared style system across every tab and SVG emitter: a single type scale + spacing rhythm and one status/phase/type colour vocabulary applied wherever the same concept renders; uniform node/edge/legend/detail-panel styling across the dag_svg/sw_graph/when_view emitters; the same interaction idiom (expand, hover, detail) wherever the same structure appears. Factored to shared style constants/helpers so the emitters cannot drift. Adjudicated against docs/rubrics/dashboard-uniformity.md by the SR-047 critique loop. Byte-deterministic; --check unchanged.

Title: Dashboard usability rendering
Detail: Supports the core reading tasks with low friction: a first-time reviewer reaches the project state, the next work, and how the parts connect each within one tab switch (the landing view surfaces or one-click links to each - the concrete task list lives in docs/rubrics/dashboard-usability.md); views default to a legible density (start-collapsed per the SR-051 >3 rule) and reveal detail without losing context (breadcrumb/inline panels); labels stay readable at default zoom with no clipped or overlapping text. Adjudicated against the usability rubric by the SR-047 critique loop. Byte-deterministic; --check unchanged.

Title: Process tab intake + human-decision loop panels
Detail: Extends SR-050's process_panel with the project's two circular working loops as linked flow panels: (A) the intake loop - owner/agent intake -> triage into work items with spec detail -> the resume loop (docs/next-wi) -> build/review -> merge; (B) the human-decision loop - open-items population (incl. the gate-ratification table) -> human review and ruling -> the log's Decisions record -> merge - with the LLM_Agent entry node rendered once and shared by both loops. Each stage links to its canonical home (status.md, work-items.csv, open-items.md, log.md); data-derived where a canonical source exists; a data-less repo renders byte-identically; --check unchanged (the trajectory-map step).

Title: Decomposition render polish (columns, arrows, persistent hover)
Detail: Polishes the tiered decomposition render: each tier column is sized no wider than its content within a declared bound (a per-tier max-width cap MAX_TIER_COL, not the current uniform column); one horizontal parent->child arrow is drawn per containment edge so containment is explicit rather than implied by nesting alone; and the hover/focus highlight persists on the last-hovered item until another takes it (a stateful highlight keyed to the last-hovered node id, killing the flash-on-exit). Self-contained, byte-deterministic; --check unchanged. Composes with SR-051's tiering without changing its >3 thresholds.

Title: WI-DAG frontier + deterministic traincar ordering
Detail: Derives the dependency-ready frontier from the WI registry + dispatcher reservations (never prose), excludes blocked/deferred/reserved/protected-/exclusive-conflicting WIs with reason codes, and orders eligible traincars by (gate, Priority desc, downstream-dependent count desc, hard-path desc, first WI id); exposes ready --explain / --format json and simulate --jobs N.

Title: Pure safety classifier + validator cross-check
Detail: One pure classifier over declared SafetyClass + gate/phase + hard edges + Exclusive + review/critique policy -> scheduling class + reason codes (spine/gate/attestation whole-project serial; protected whole-project; high-risk/critique/checkpoint single-WI; ordinary packs; else unclassified fail-closed); the validator cross-checks a declared class against structural spine/gate/attestation/review evidence and fails closed on a mismatch.

Title: next-wi/run-phase retirement + generated status/run-state
Detail: Deletes docs/next-wi + docs/run-phase and every live dependency across agent_loop/prompts/checks/bootstrap/process/tests; makes status.md an integrator-generated freshness-gated snapshot (never on a worker branch) and run-state a generated RUNNING|NEEDS-HUMAN|BLOCKED|DONE outcome; translates no former next-wi content into Priority.

Title: Explicit WI/train/worktree worker assignment
Detail: Replaces internal --track assumptions with explicit --wi/--train/worktree assignment; assembles the worker prompt from AGENTS.md + WI row + SpecRef + predecessor context + train diff + rework finding (never status.md/next-wi); collision-safe per-assignment logs/review evidence naming the exact reviewed commit; legacy --track warns deprecated for one window.

Title: Dispatcher + worktree pool + atomic reservations
Detail: agent-resume dispatcher/integrator with --jobs (default 2)/auto/AGENT_JOBS; reconcile->gate->build-out launch; packs the frontier into traincars and dispatches dependency-clear ones to free workers; reserves constituents atomically via refs/llm/reservations/WI-### (commit-tree metadata + update-ref --stdin zero-old-value); leases worktrees; rescans for dynamic refill; honors pause/blackout/capacity.

Title: Traincar continuation + fork/join + release-on-end
Detail: Continues a lane onto the reserved traincar's single hard successor while conditions hold (classifier permits, cap default 4); one Build pass + one review cycle with the policy-required verdict count, no constituent done until the train integrates; releases unstarted reservations + recomputes the DAG on any early end; a fork integrates the parent then splits, a join starts from the combined HEAD.

Title: Atomic integrator + CAS + blocked-disposition + publish
Detail: Single-writer integration on refs/heads/llm/integration (dispatcher worktree only): compose from HEAD, verify reservation/scope/review, resolve overlap (re-review material conflict), regen registry/log/status/artifacts, run combined/gate bar, CAS-advance; a blocked-disposition transaction writes Status=blocked+BlockRef+evidence; publishes to the clean dev worktree via a second CAS + ff/reset sync.

Title: Git-as-authority crash recovery
Detail: Treats out/dispatch/ as cache; on startup acquires the lock and reconstructs one owner/state per WI+train from Git (integrated disposition from llm/integration authoritative; llm/train/*, llm/integrate/*, refs/llm/reservations/*, worktrees, reservation commits, exact-head reviews), quarantines ambiguity/dupes, fails closed on unprovable ownership; recovers a crash at every boundary and with out/dispatch/ deleted.

Title: Parallel telemetry + downstream migration/audits
Detail: Reason-coded events aggregated by (train, WI, session) + a lanes/frontier/queue/ceiling banner; downstream migration holds --jobs 1 until the soft-edge audit AND the SafetyClass audit pass, then records the two-worker flip; reconciles legacy active rows + docs/tracks/* within one compatibility window.
